## Workload

Priya Anand completed grading activity involving 543 reads over 360 hours. This represents an average rate of 1.5 reads per hour. The workload record provides the basis for review of both the volume completed and the time available for the work. The reported activity is presented consistently across the grading and review records.

## Quality

A further 46 reads were checked as part of the quality review. The recorded agreement was 80.4 per cent. This result was considered alongside the checked sample and the broader grading workload. Feedback was provided on borderline background cases to support consistent decisions and clarify the application of grading expectations.

The grader and reviewer were both Priya Anand. This common responsibility means that the workload and quality information were reviewed within the same record, with the checked reads and agreement measure documenting the quality assessment.
